plugin.name: BREAKMED
plugin.description: Generative tracker jungle break slicer: weighted chains (pitch, sub, glitch, reverse, drill), Paula sampler, hit log

Sampler: Slice threshold (TRANS: 2 = every onset, 64 = strongest; EQUAL: parts)
Memory (a variation falls back to BASE)
Play: Play (built-in player: the break in its own order)
Vary lock (same variation at the same place)
Inputs: Slice (1 V/oct, 0 V = slice 00; unpatched = next slice)
Vary CV (scales the six variation weights, +-5 V = x0..x2)
Outputs: Slice of the last hit (1/12 V per slice)
